title: OneNote on iPhone: Copilot chat pane with page summaries and Q&A
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, licence requirement and automatic availability agree with Microsoft's notice and roadmap. The licence assignment path and PowerShell call are documented, as is the broader connected experiences control for OneNote on iOS.

claims.claim: Microsoft is introducing a Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile on iPhone.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing a new Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile (iPhone) for users licensed with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).

claims.claim: The pane lets users generate concise summaries of longer OneNote pages.
claims.quote: This update adds a new Summary feature that allows users to generate concise summaries of longer OneNote pages

claims.claim: Users can ask questions about their notes directly within OneNote Mobile.
claims.quote: as well as ask questions about their notes, directly within the OneNote mobile app.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes summaries as helping users consume relevant information faster.
claims.quote: you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes real-time answers to queries directly within notes.
claims.quote: With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes

claims.claim: Licences can be assigned in Microsoft 365 admin center through Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote:
1. In the admin center, go to the **Billing** > Licenses page.
2. Select a product.
3. On the product details page, select **Assign licenses**.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK command Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Turning off connected experiences that analyse content makes Copilot features unavailable in current OneNote apps on iOS.
claims.quote:
If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users in the following apps:
- Excel
- OneNote
- Outlook
- PowerPoint
- Word

claims.claim: The connected experiences control is broader than a switch specifically for the new pane.
claims.quote: This applies to when you're running the most current version of these apps on Windows, Mac, iOS, or Android devices.

claims.claim: The iOS Cloud Policy setting is named Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content.
claims.quote:
You can also use Cloud Policy and these four policy settings:
- Configure the level of client software diagnostic data sent by Office to Microsoft
- Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content

claims.claim: Cloud Policy can scope a policy configuration to specific groups.
claims.quote: On the **Choose the scope** page, determine whether the policy configuration applies to all users, specific groups, or to users who anonymously access documents using Office for the web.
